name: smwmusic-crash-team-racing-hot-air-skyway
title: Crash Team Racing - Hot Air Skyway
description:
An upbeat theme that plays in Hot Air Skyway, a sky track that is essentially the Rainbow Road of Crash Team Racing.

You can define in the .txt file if you want to use the normal version or the pre-console version which is slightly longer.

Originally requested by bandicoot.
